data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: data-backup-manager
service.description: Dependable, engine-backed backup and verified restore for Vrooli runtime state. Scenarios self-register the state they own (databases, filesystem trees, vector and cache stores); the manager snapshots it on a schedule to one or more encrypted kopia destinations and proves it can restore — making runtime state safe to keep out of git.

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o data-backup-manager-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

kopia.description: Wrapped backup engine: one kopia repository per destination. All snapshot/restore/verify/stats/retention go through resource-kopia. Encryption is always on; kopia owns repository passphrases via vault.

vault.description: Holds repository passphrases and source/backend access keys. Secrets are referenced (never copied) by the catalog; the kopia and source resource CLIs source actual values from vault at call time.

postgres.description: Conditional source kind: pg_dump of a Postgres target via the postgres resource CLI. Enable when a Postgres target is registered.

redis.description: Conditional source kind: best-effort prefix SCAN+DUMP of a Redis target via the redis resource CLI. Enable when a Redis target is registered.

qdrant.description: Conditional source kind: collection snapshot of a Qdrant target via the qdrant resource CLI. Enable when a Qdrant target is registered.

minio.description: Conditional: backs object-storage source mirrors and S3-backed destinations. Enable when an S3/MinIO source or destination is used.
